def find_permutation(n, p):
    # Create an array to store the inverse of p
    inv_p = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        inv_p[p[i]] = i + 1

    # Create the result array
    q = [0] * n

    # Compute q[i] = p^(-1)[p^(-1)[i]]
    for i in range(n):
        q[i] = inv_p[inv_p[i + 1]]

    # Check if q^2 = p
    p_squared = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        p_squared[i] = p[q[i] - 1]

    if p_squared == p:
        return q
    else:
        return [-1]

# Read input
n = int(input())
p = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Find and print the result
result = find_permutation(n, p)
if result[0] == -1:
    print(-1)
else:
    print(*result)
